cases.workflow:
jobs:
  verify:
    steps:
      - run: |
          # uses: actions/checkout@v4
          fetch-depth: 0
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$P" HEAD
      - run: |
          import json, pathlib
          p=pathlib.Path("RTEST_RUNTIME_MANIFEST.json")
          d=json.loads(p.read_text())
          assert d["seed"] == 1
